references.text: Daniel sees a vision of one like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, which mirrors the description of the Son of Man in Matthew.
Zechariah prophesies that the people will look on the one they have pierced, which may be connected to the mourning of the nations in Matthew when they see the Son of Man coming.
The glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together, which is similar to how everyone will see the Son of Man coming in glory.
Jesus tells the high priest that he will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven, directly related to the description in Matthew 24:30.
The Revelation of John describes how everyone will see him, even those who pierced him, which mirrors the mourning of the nations and the recognition of the Son of Man in Matthew.
